column1: # Formatting truth table for src/model/units.rs: one case per line, tab separated.
# `value` is canonical metric/SI (temp_c, wind_kmh, pressure_hpa, distance_km, precip_mm).
# `unit spec` is either a whole system (metric, us, uk) or one unit token (c, f, kmh, mph, mps,
# knots, hpa, inhg, mmhg, km, mi, mm, in), which is applied as an override on top of metric.
# `expected` is exactly the string the formatter returns, including the unit symbol.
